name: Deactivate Inactive Users
description: Blocks (deactivates) user accounts that have been inactive for a configured number of days, via cron, with warning emails and optional self-service unblock.
project_description:
Security best practices (and indeed the NIST 800-53 security controls) require users who have not used a system in a defined period of time to be deactivated (blocked, in Drupal parlance.)

 This module allows the administrator to specify the number of days before a user is deactivated, and when they're unblocked how long that unblock lasts before they are re-deactivated.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing, go to Configuration > Users > Deactivate users and configure as needed. The time to actual blocking of a user is "Inactivity Limit" + "Grace Period". Some sites set it as 85 and 5 to achieve their required 90 days blocking. Be sure to personalize the email templates for your site.
